rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent stepped bent-bar mass in all four views, so gesture clarity and hierarchy are acceptable. The silhouette is not merely arbitrary tiering; it forms a continuous cascading ribbon, which aligns reasonably with the neighborhood-living brief and with the terraced references. However, the access edge is still weakly expressed: the blue frontage line does not receive a clearly carved court, notch, or undercut, so the public threshold remains under-articulated. The form also leans toward a scenic stepped landform more than an active street building, which keeps program appropriateness and section-program fit below a hard pass. The mass is coherent, but it needs a more legible ground void/open side aligned to the verified access edge to satisfy the semantic invariants.
